scope: Execute data/source qualification and post hoc diagnosis of archived predictions; no new fitted policy or biological confirmation
population: All 106 previously evaluated contexts, now exposed; retain all six archived arms and every missing endpoint
endpoint: Negative mean published exact-dose PRISM HTS log2-fold-change of the ten committed future drugs; same prescribed terminal menu for every archived arm
terminal_menu: All 3621 archived drug groups except the eight frozen probes; no hidden-availability-based replacement
decisions: Read immutable archived commitments only; ranking bands use the prefeedback zero-purchase predictions and stable drug-index tie ordering

rank_bands.remainder: Prior ranks 31 through the end of the fixed menu

pairwise_diagnostic: Squared error of predicted response differences for all prior-rank-1-10 vs prior-rank-11-20 pairs with both outcomes observed; retain context as the descriptive unit
mse_diagnostic: Same finite truth mask for all arms, with separate prefeedback rank bands; no MSE-based promotion
selection_loss: Sum of true responses of removed drugs minus sum of true responses of added drugs, divided by ten, equals candidate-minus-prior utility when both selections are complete
perfect_information_reference: Exact best ten only if the entire fixed terminal menu is measured; otherwise exact utility and regret are null
partial_information_reference: Best ten among measured outcomes, minus a complete committed baseline, is an observed-subset hindsight LOWER bound on unknown full-menu realized regret; never a policy, EVSI or finite upper bound
cost_basis: Existing scenario prices per declared read equivalent; zero purchase costs zero, every paid archived arm costs ten; actual assay and API prices remain unestablished
source_qualification: Audit original treatment/pool/source metadata before opening any newly downloaded candidate response panel; independent plate IDs alone do not establish independent cultures
mechanism_claim: No compensation/stress/platform-cause classification without a qualified discriminating observation and experimental design
statistics: Descriptive post hoc summaries; no significance tests, new superiority gate or multiplicity-adjusted scientific claim
continue_rule: P0 execution can complete with a negative or non-evaluable result. Preserve the fixed-eight-probe stop; a new model/Agent study requires a qualified distinct evidence channel or independently justified task and a new frozen protocol
